# A generated file is current only after its generator was re-run and compared

- Source: the user, 2026-10-15; the text ratified by questionnaire and placed in CLAUDE.md, "Tidiness and governance".
- Scope: any generated file in this project: `morphogen.js`, `docs/adr/ADR_INDEX.md`, the rendered media, and any added later.

The CLAUDE.md text this record promotes:

> DO NOT present a generated (i.e. any conventionally automated or AI-generated) file as current unless its generator was re-run this session and its output compared with the file; DO NOT leave a generated file without a header that names the tool that produces it;
